prompt:
Create one realistic vertical 9:16 product-review photograph. REFERENCE 1 is the exact product; REFERENCE 2 is the canonical fictional adult identity. Exactly ONE pastel lavender portable power bank as shown in product reference 1: a compact thick rounded rectangular smooth lavender body, glossy BLACK rounded-rectangle level window inset at one end of the broad front face, existing small white level markings, matching lavender loop strap and the original shell seam/visible side openings. Preserve the supplied body proportions and black window location. Do not add any brand, connector, port, cable, charging feature or invented value. The loop is treated only as a strap. Always show the existing front face at nearly its original three-quarter angle; only a small 5–8 degree yaw is permitted. Never expose an invented rear.
The exact fictional adult Vietnamese woman in reference image 2, about 28 years old, same oval face, eyes, nose, lips, medium warm skin tone, dark hair in a neat low ponytail, plain cream cotton blouse with long sleeves and dark trousers, short natural nails, no jewelry. Copy her face and tied-back hairstyle consistently; do not create a new woman. She is calm and friendly, lips relaxed and closed; narration is separate male Adam voice-over.
One bright clean product-review studio styled as a small electronics shop: pale oak counter, soft warm-white neutral wall and a few heavily blurred unbranded accessories, no readable signs or packaging. Broad FIXED diffuse studio key light plus fill at neutral 5200K. No visible window, sunlight beam, moving shadow, RGB lights or dark background transition. Keep identical bright exposure and neutral white balance in all scenes, especially the lavender body and cream sleeves.
Tabletop medium-close view cropped below the woman's chin. Power bank supported above counter in left palm at its original front-facing angle, right fingertips poised near the blank lavender face. A plain black phone lies FACE DOWN at least 15 cm away on the counter, unconnected. No cable or charger adapter. Entire product and loop centered with generous margins.
Natural realistic palm-sized scale, normal fingers. Keep body and full loop inside central 70% with 15–20% margins. Do not manufacture a different face, hairstyle or blouse. No added text anywhere, no captions, titles, signs, subtitles, promotional cards, logos or watermark. Keep only physical markings originally on product. Bright steady neutral fill, no dramatic grade or vignette.
STRAP COUNT LOCK: exactly ONE short flexible lavender loop attached at the SAME location as product reference 1. Keep its original approximate length, no longer than one product body length. Do not add a second loop, long wrist lanyard, cord, hanging extension, extra attachment or cable. The one original loop must be visible. Do not invent extra ports.
